description: Resolve an ENS name to its Ethereum address (plus optional text records like avatar, url, com.twitter), or reverse-resolve an address to its forward-verified primary ENS name. Read-only, public RPC. Price: $0.005 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: GET https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/ens-resolve

address.description: 0x address for reverse lookup (use instead of name)

texts.description: Text record keys to fetch on forward lookup, e.g. avatar,url,com.twitter (comma-separated)

name: ens_resolve
title: Ens Resolve
